title: X-Claude-Code-Session-Id Request Header (v2.1.86) — Proxy Session Aggregation

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic feature, zero integration friction (already injected automatically). Capability expansion is low for the current Max plan setup (no custom proxy), but this is forward-useful knowledge when LiteLLM or Cloudflare proxy is introduced for cost accounting. The session ID enables per-session token cost tracking at the proxy layer — relevant to heartbeat cost monitoring and future bloat-metrics integration. Action: registry note only. Document in existing-capabilities.md under a new 'API Headers' or 'Proxy Integration' row. No settings change needed; the header is automatic. Reference this when evaluating any future proxy setup.
